text.p: SEALEDBIDS will be received until 11:00 o'clock A.M., C.D.T., on

at the Gallatin City Hall in Gallatin, Tennessee, at a rate or rates not exceeding 7%, on an all or none basis as to the Bonds. The Bonds will be issued in fully registered form and will be dated August 1, 1997. The Bonds will mature on August 1 in each of the years 1998 through 2017, inclusive. No bid will be considered for less than ninety-nine percent (99%) of par and accrued interest, and the Bonds will be awarded on the basis of the lowest true interest rate to the City, being that rate which, when used in computing the present worth of all payments of principal and interest to be paid on the Bonds (compounded semi-annually from the dated date of the Bonds), produces an amount equal to the purchase price exclusive of accrued interest. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date by the Mayor of the City. The Bonds will be issued as qualified tax-exempt
obligations'' within the meaning of Section 265 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986.

The Bonds maturing August 1, 2006 and thereafter are callable on August 1, 2005 as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed bonds and approving opinions of Wyatt, Tarrant & Combs will be furnished at the expense of the City. Additional information, including the Detailed Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement which has been deemed final as of its date by the City except for the omission of pricing and certain other information, may be obtained from the undersigned at the Gallatin City Hall, 132 West Main Street, Gallatin, Tennessee 37066 or from Jim Vogel, First Tennessee Bank National Association, 845
